entry.title: Roads 1.2.3
entry.summary: ## What's new - Rebuilt on the current [open-mpc/mpc-vst-plugins](https://github.com/open-mpc/mpc-vst-plugins) toolkit, including the wrapper fix for small buffer sizes (input and output sharing one buffer). - The plugin folder carries a `plugin.json`, so on MPC OS 3.10.1 it can be copied by hand into `VST2 Plugins`. - New: `Roads-1.2.3-mpc-sdk.zip`, the Akai SDK folder format (MPC OS 3.10.1 and later). entry.title: Roads 1.2.2
entry.summary: An electric piano (tine, reed and clav characters) with tremolo / auto-pan, chorus, an envelope filter and EQ. A native MPC OS plugin (instrument) with its own MPC screen skin, loaded by MPC's built-in plugin host. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61).
